main_text.p: 7. Si centum aurei sortis, quinq; aureorum usuram in singulos annos afferunt, quanto tempore e 56 aureis, usura 12 aureorum redibit?

p.i: In hac quaestione cum maior usura de minore sorte quaeratur, manifesta fit reciprocatio: quae quo minor sors datur, eo plus temporis postulat. Quocirca descriptis ut decet terminis, ijsq; decussatim multiplicatis, scrupulus per Regulam expedietur:

main_text.head: CAPVT XXI.
De multiplici proportione multiplicatione & additione composita.
main_text.p: ANTVM de exèplis proportionis uel additioe, uel multiplicatione sola, compositæ: progrediendum ad eam, quæ utramq; numerationis speciem coniungit.

page.notes: Woodcut initial I at the start of the paragraph "Antum". Left-edge fragments of the facing page are cropped and omitted. Fraction and Greek-free text; catchword "Pro-" printed at foot right.
